COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated basophils, high ferritin, LDH, CRP, and INR. These findings suggest possible acute inflammation or infection, with evidence of bone marrow suppression or dysfunction. The elevated INR may indicate coagulopathy. Further clinical correlation and urgent evaluation for underlying causes such as infection, sepsis, or hematologic disorder are recommended.
